name: navigator-accessor-suffix
source: (()=>{const names=['userAgent','appName','appCodeName','appVersion','platform','language','languages','onLine','cookieEnabled','hardwareConcurrency','deviceMemory','maxTouchPoints','vendor','product','webdriver','plugins','doNotTrack','globalPrivacyControl'];const rows=names.map(name=>{const d=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Navigator.prototype,name),own=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(navigator,name);return{name,prototypeDescriptor:d?{enumerable:d.enumerable,configurable:d.configurable,getType:typeof d.get,valueType:typeof d.value,getSource:typeof d.get==='function'?Function.prototype.toString.call(d.get):null}:null,ownDescriptor:own?{getType:typeof own.get,valueType:typeof own.value}:null,functional:{getter:typeof d?.get==='function',noData:typeof d?.value==='undefined',notOwn:own===undefined,nativeSource:typeof d?.get==='function'&&Function.prototype.toString.call(d.get).includes('[native code]')}}});return{observed:rows,functional:{all18:rows.length===18&&rows.every(r=>Object.values(r.functional).every(Boolean))}}})()

name: xhr-headers-heldout
source: new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const x=new XMLHttpRequest();x.onload=()=>{try{const observed=JSON.parse(x.responseText),got=observed.headers;resolve({observed,actualNavigator:{userAgent:navigator.userAgent,clientHints:navigator.userAgentData.toJSON()},originalBrandLiteral:{userAgentIncludesLightpanda:got['user-agent']?.includes('Lightpanda')===true,clientHintsIncludesLightpanda:got['sec-ch-ua']?.includes('Lightpanda')===true},functional:{status:x.status===200,acceptLanguage:got['accept-language']==='fr',multi:got['x-multi']==='a, b',noAuthoredMozilla:got['user-agent']?.includes('Mozilla')===false,noAuthoredChromium:got['sec-ch-ua']?.includes('Chromium')===false,noInjectedCookie:!(got.cookie??'').includes('injected'),noProxyHeader:got['proxy-test']===undefined,noSecHeader:got['sec-test']===undefined,noOverride:got['x-http-method-override']===undefined}})}catch(e){reject(e)}};x.onerror=()=>reject(Error('actual XHR transport error'));x.open('GET','/echo?control=xhr');for(const[k,v]of[['Accept-Language','fr'],['X-Multi','a'],['X-Multi','b'],['User-Agent','Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64)'],['Sec-Ch-Ua','"Chromium";v="140"'],['Cookie','injected=1'],['Proxy-Test','1'],['Sec-Test','1'],['X-HTTP-Method-Override','TRACE']])x.setRequestHeader(k,v);x.send()})
